title: The Octopus That Solved the Puzzle
short_teaser: Octopuses can open containers, navigate mazes, and explore objects with remarkable flexibility.
story: Octopuses can open containers, navigate mazes, and explore objects with remarkable flexibility. Much of their nervous system extends through their arms, creating a form of intelligence very different from our own. Wonder grows when we encounter capable minds organized in unfamiliar ways. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
